input.prompt: Promising medicines can wait on the work of clinical trials. Meet Protocol Pulse.<#0.25#> Open a trial protocol. AI proposes clear, source-linked rules. A clinical lead reviews and approves.<#0.3#> Now screen thirty synthetic patients. Potential matches, conflicts, and missing evidence stay distinct. An order alone doesn't prove a medicine was taken.<#0.3#> Confirm participation, and the workflow keeps going.<#0.25#> A new medication record arrives. Approved rules flag a conflict. AI investigates the evidence and drafts a cited summary.<#0.3#> The clinical lead reviews the case and records the next step.<#0.25#> Less repetitive work. More focused oversight.<#0.25#> Protocol Pulse. Keep the trial moving. Bring tomorrow's medicines closer.

recipe.note: These are the submitted inputs, not resolved server defaults. For a variation, copy them and change only requested fields; reuse returned_seed when supported by the schema. Source URLs may expire.

next_action.reason: The result is in this reply. Pass it and its recipe unchanged in this one-item jobs list; don't read the job again. If this host doesn't render MCP app UI, share the media URLs instead.

display_hint: Present completed media to the user. Forward attached image content blocks to the host's image display helper (for example, image(block)); do not stringify image blocks as text. For Markdown previews use previews[].preview_url, and separately link original_url as the full-resolution file. If no preview is available, show a clearly labeled original-file link. Do not claim a preview rendered unless it is visible. Video, audio and 3D URLs are original result files, not queue URLs.
next_steps: After presenting the result, offer a next generation: variations (copy recipe.input and change the text, voice or prompt), or pairing it with a video (lip sync or a soundtrack). Submit several variations together in one submit_jobs call. For a new operation on this output, call recommend_model with its URL as the source.
